<!-- HOSTING RULE OF THUMB
     Small files (under a few MB): fine in assets/data/ in this repo.
     Anything larger: put it in a repository built for it and link out.
       - Zenodo — free, gives you a DOI, versioned, no size anxiety
       - OSF — good for research materials and preregistrations
       - Dryad — common in some fields
       - GitHub — for code, not for large data files

     Zenodo is the right default. A DOI makes the dataset citable, which means
     it counts on your CV as a research output rather than a file on a website.
     GitHub Pages caps the published site at 1 GB, so large files will break
     the deploy anyway.

     LICENSE EVERY RELEASE. Unlicensed means legally unusable, which defeats
     the point of posting it. Common choices:
       - CC BY 4.0 for data — attribution required, otherwise permissive
       - MIT or Apache 2.0 for code
       - CC0 for anything you want maximally reusable
     Pick one per item and state it in the entry. -->

## Restricted materials

Some materials cannot be posted publicly — data under a use agreement,
instruments still in use, work under embargo. [Email me](contact.qmd) with what
you need and how you plan to use it.

## Citing this work

If you use a dataset or tool from this page, please cite it directly rather than
citing the paper alone. Each entry above links to a record with a DOI and a
suggested citation.
